name: context-relevancy-benchmark-vitaminc-dataset
description: A benchmark for judging whether a provided context passage is relevant to a given query and supporting evidence retrieval. Each example pairs a query with candidate context(s) and annotations indicating relevance or supporting evidence, intended to evaluate models' context-selection and evidence-detection capabilities.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face as a niche benchmark; modest community usage and limited citation outside dataset hosting.
